text:
mara: Quick heads-up — I opened a small docs PR to add a migration note for Optimize quantization profiles and an extra SDK snippet for prefix caching. Need a quick review before tomorrow's docs freeze. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4521 :hourglass:
josh: Thanks — tagging to review. Is the SDK snippet in JS/Go both?
rina: Ping — do we need to include the perf numbers (latency/cost) for the example? That helped in previous migration notes.
mara: Primary snippet is JS; added a short Go snippet too (file under examples/optkit). I kept perf numbers conservative — local bench on T4: ~12ms/token with 8k prefix cache hit, quantized int8. I put that under a collapsed note so it doesn't dominate the page.
ben: Can you add a one-line callout to the Console link where users configure prefixes? We keep getting support tickets for that.
mara: Good call. Added a link to Console -> Optimize -> Prefetch rules. Also updated internal anchor so external link works: /console/optimize/prefetch#rules.
docs-bot: checklist: [x] PR opened, [ ] reviewer assigned, [ ] snippets linted, [ ] links validated, [ ] perf note copyedited
josh: I'll take reviewer. Will skim for technical accuracy; focus on code correctness and whether the caching behavior matches runtime semantics.
rina: Quick note on wording: for quant profiles avoid saying "lossless" — we should say "minimal observed quality delta" and link to evals guide.
mara: Updated wording per rina. Also added crosslink to /docs/optimize/evals/regression-alerts.
ben: Small nit: the Go snippet uses `CachePrefetcher` but in SDK we renamed to `PrefetchClient` a month ago. Could be confusing.
mara: Ah — good catch. WIll update snippet ASAP.
ci-bot: build status for PR #4521: checks/quick-md-lint passed, snippets/format-check failed (1 file)
mara: Fixing formatting now.
(2 minutes later)
mara: pushed a tiny commit to fix Go snippet and run `gofmt`. Also removed an unused import in JS example.
ci-bot: build status for PR #4521: snippets/format-check passed, link-checker found 1 external link redirect (console link)
josh: Which external link?
mara: It's the marketplace link for a partner integration; it's a 301 -> new URL. I updated it to the canonical URL.
docs-bot: checklist: [x] PR opened, [x] reviewer assigned, [x] snippets linted, [x] links validated, [ ] perf note copyedited
rina: Perf note: can you add the test conditions (batch size, seq len, quant profile id) so readers can replicate? Keep it succinct.
mara: Added a tiny table-like bullet under the perf note: - batch: 8 - seq: 1024 prefix hit - quant profile: qprof-small-int8 — linker to qprof page.\en: sorry small typo above: linker -> link
mara: corrected.
ben: I'm good with this. If rina's happy with wording and josh signs off, we can merge before freeze.
josh: Code looks good to me. One suggestion: for the JS snippet swap `await prefetch()` to `prefetch().catch()` pattern to avoid unhandled rejections in examples.
mara: Done. Updated snippet and pushed.
docs-bot: checklist: [x] PR opened, [x] reviewer assigned, [x] snippets linted, [x] links validated, [x] perf note copyedited
ben: Merged?
mara: Merged & deployed to staging docs. Link to preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/optimize/migration-quickverify
josh: Quick smoke: looks good, examples render, code blocks have syntax highlight.
rina: Verified that the quant profile link points to the correct profile page. lgtm.
ben: Thanks all — saved us from a batch of support tickets tomorrow. :tada:
